questions.question: The G20 (Group of Twenty) is best described as:

options.A: A military alliance of NATO member states
options.B: An international forum comprising major developed and developing economies that discusses global economic cooperation and policy
options.C: A United Nations specialised agency for public health
options.D: A regional trade bloc limited to South Asian countries

questions.explanation: The G20 is a premier international forum bringing together major developed and developing economies to coordinate on global economic issues such as financial stability, trade, and sustainable development; it is not a military alliance or a UN agency.

questions.sub: Urban development schemes: AMRUT, Smart Cities, PMAY-U, Swachh Bharat Urban
questions.question: The urban development scheme 'AMRUT', launched by the Government of India, stands for:

options.A: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation
options.B: All India Mission for Rural Upliftment and Technology
options.C: Advanced Metro and Rural Urban Transport
options.D: Aadhaar Mission for Rural Urban Transformation

questions.explanation: AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation) focuses on providing basic civic infrastructure such as water supply, sewerage, and urban transport in selected cities and towns.

questions.sub: Urban development schemes: AMRUT, Smart Cities, PMAY-U, Swachh Bharat Urban
questions.question: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U) is a flagship scheme primarily aimed at:

options.A: Providing free higher education to urban youth
options.B: Providing affordable pucca housing to the urban poor and homeless
options.C: Building highways connecting rural and urban areas
options.D: Providing free electricity to urban households

questions.explanation: PMAY-U aims to achieve 'Housing for All' in urban areas by providing affordable, pucca housing with basic amenities to eligible urban poor and homeless beneficiaries.

questions.sub: Urban development schemes: AMRUT, Smart Cities, PMAY-U, Swachh Bharat Urban
questions.question: Swachh Bharat Mission – Urban (SBM-U) primarily focuses on:

options.B: Achieving universal sanitation coverage, eliminating open defecation, and improving solid waste management in urban areas

questions.explanation: SBM-U's core objectives include eliminating open defecation, achieving universal sanitation coverage through the construction of household and community toilets, and scientific solid waste management in urban areas.

questions.sub: Urban development schemes: AMRUT, Smart Cities, PMAY-U, Swachh Bharat Urban
questions.question: The Smart Cities Mission, launched by the Government of India, primarily aims to:

options.A: Build entirely new cities from scratch only
options.B: Develop selected cities with core infrastructure, a clean and sustainable environment, and 'smart' technology-driven solutions for a better quality of urban life
options.C: Relocate all rural populations into cities

questions.explanation: The Smart Cities Mission focuses on area-based development and the application of smart technology solutions in selected cities to improve core infrastructure, service delivery, and citizens' quality of life; it does not mandate building cities from scratch or privatising governance.

questions.question: The Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, may be conferred for exceptional service in which of the following fields?

options.C: Any field of human endeavour, without restriction, including art, literature, science, and public service

questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is awarded for exceptional service or performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavour, without restriction of profession, position, or gender.

questions.question: The Padma awards in India are conferred in how many categories, listed here in descending order of precedence?

options.A: Two: Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan
options.B: Three: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri
options.D: One single category called the Padma Award

questions.explanation: The Padma awards, India's civilian honours next in precedence after the Bharat Ratna, are conferred in three categories in descending order: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.

questions.question: The Nobel Prize, established as per the will of Alfred Nobel, was originally awarded in how many categories, before the later addition of the Economic Sciences prize by Sveriges Riksbank?
questions.explanation: Alfred Nobel's will established prizes in five original categories: Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, and Peace. The Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences was added later, in 1968, in memory of Alfred Nobel.

questions.question: The acronym 'BRICS' originally referred to a grouping of which five major emerging economies?

options.A: Bangladesh, Russia, India, China, South Africa
options.B: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa

questions.explanation: BRICS originally referred to the grouping of Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa — major emerging national economies that cooperate on economic and geopolitical matters.

questions.question: World Environment Day is observed annually on which date?
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is observed on 5 June each year to promote awareness and action for environmental protection. (22 April is Earth Day, 16 September is World Ozone Day, and 8 March is International Women's Day.)
